flat:
TASK
Add rate limiting to the public API, 100 requests per minute per key

CONTEXT
Node 22, Fastify, Postgres via Drizzle, tests in Vitest.

FOLLOW THIS PATTERN
Mirror src/routes/webhooks.ts.

DONE MEANS
npm test passes and curl -I returns 429 on the 101st call. Run it yourself before you report back, and quote the output.

DO NOT TOUCH
Do not touch the auth middleware or any migration older than 0042.

RULES
No new dependencies.

WORKING METHOD
Explore the relevant files first and tell me the plan before you edit anything. Implement in one pass, run the check, then report what changed and what you did not change.
notes: Break work into verified checkpoints. Use Playbooks for procedures and Knowledge for standards that persist.
warnings: Rules files are hard-capped: 6,000 characters global, 12,000 per workspace file. A longer file silently truncates.
Windsurf is now Devin Desktop. .devin/ beats .windsurf/, and leftover Windsurf configs can be shadowed.

variations.name: Add one example
variations.text: Paste a short example of exactly the answer you want. One example outperforms a paragraph describing the format.

variations.name: Name the reader
variations.text: Add who reads this and what they will do with it. It changes what the model chooses to include more than any other line.

variations.name: Ask for the objections
variations.text: Add: end with the three strongest objections to your own answer, and say which one you find hardest to dismiss.
